name: sop-knowledge-worlds
description: Knowledge worlds for sopworld, in SOP Lang, served from GitHub Pages

scripts.build: node tools/render-svg.mjs && node tools/render-scenes.mjs && node tools/check-preview-page.mjs && node tools/derive.mjs && node tools/geo-aliases.mjs && node tools/joins.mjs && node tools/attributes-glosses.mjs && node tools/kinds-core.mjs && node tools/relations-core.mjs && node tools/joins-report.mjs && node tools/structures-core.mjs && node tools/diagram-topics.mjs && node tools/expect-core.mjs && node tools/narration-core.mjs && node tools/lang-en-diagram-frames.mjs && node tools/lang-en-person-frames.mjs && node tools/outlines-core.mjs && node tools/lang-en-shape-frames.mjs && node tools/lang-en-list-frames.mjs && node tools/lang-en-arithmetic.mjs && node tools/lang-en-time-frames.mjs && node tools/lang-en-variants.mjs && node tools/lang-en-closed.mjs && node tools/lang-en-core.mjs && node tools/lang-en-catalog-plurals.mjs && node tools/lang-en-morph.mjs && node tools/forms-report.mjs && node tools/sensitive-core.mjs && node tools/counts.mjs && node tools/build-catalog.mjs
scripts.reports: node tools/build-catalog.mjs && node tools/coverage-report.mjs && node tools/aspects-report.mjs && node tools/build-catalog.mjs
scripts.regenerate: node tools/measures-core.mjs && npm run --silent build && node tools/generated.mjs && (node tools/coverage-report.mjs && node tools/aspects-report.mjs && node tools/build-catalog.mjs || echo 'COVERAGE.md and ASPECTS.md need the raw files: left as main has them')
scripts.check-generated: node tools/counts.mjs --check && node tools/generated.mjs --check && node tools/build-catalog.mjs --check
